item.title: Aus Open: Yuki Bhambri Advances, Sriram Balaji Loses Men's Doubles Round Two
item.description: Yuki Bhambri: India's Yuki Bhambri and his partner Andre Goransson of Sweden fought back from a set behind to beat Mexico’s Santiago Gonzalez and the Netherlands’ David Pel in the men's doubles second round at the Australian Open 2026 on Saturday. India, however, suffered a setback as another star, Sriram Balaji, and his partner went out of the competition at Melbourne Park.

item.title: India vs New Zealand, 3rd T20I- Who will win today IND vs NZ match?
item.description: The third T20I between India and New Zealand will be played at Barsapara Cricket Stadium on Sunday at 7 PM IST.

item.title: PGTI Tour: American Jhared Hack Tops Pre-Qualifying III With Three-shot Margin, 26 Players Qualify For Final Stage
item.description: Muhammad Nafis Najmie Bin Darnalis: American Jhared Hack posted a four-under 68 in the second round that helped him take the top honours with a comfortable three-shot margin at the Pre-Qualifying III leg of the PGTI Qualifying School 2026 played at the Kensville Golf & Country Club in Ahmedabad on Saturday.

item.title: Joe Root Anchors England’s Gritty ODI Win to Level Series Against Sri Lanka
item.description: Joe Root’s composed 75 guided England to a five-wicket win over Sri Lanka on a turning Colombo track, levelling the ODI series with a game to spare.

item.title: La Liga: Mbappe's Brace Take Real Madrid On Top; Osasuna End Away Jinx
item.description: Athletic Club Bilbao: Real Madrid moved to the top of La Liga with a 2-0 away win over third-placed Villarreal.

item.title: 'We Are Not Here Just To Qualify But To Seal The Top Spot': Malolan Reacts After RCB's Loss To DC
item.description: After Royal Challengers Bengaluru: After Royal Challengers Bengaluru’s (RCB) five-match winning streak in the WPL 2026 came to a halt with a loss to Delhi Capitals, acting head coach Malolan Rangarajan made it clear that qualification alone is not RCB’s benchmark for success, stressing that the focus remains firmly on finishing at the top of the table.

item.title: Australian Open: Aryna Sabalenka Reaches Quarterfinals, Breaks Grand Slam Tiebreak Record
item.description: World No. 1 Aryna Sabalenka defeated Victoria Mboko 6-1, 7-6(1) to reach her fourth straight Australian Open quarterfinal and set a new Grand Slam tiebreak record.

item.title: 'A Sad Moment For Cricket,' Says World Cricketers' Association Chief On Bangladesh's Withdrawal From T20 WC
item.description: The International Cricket Council: The World Cricketers' Association (WCA) has expressed deep concern following Bangladesh’s withdrawal from the Men’s T20 World Cup 2026 after the International Cricket Council (ICC) rejected the Bangladesh Cricket Board's (BCB) request to shift its matches from India to Sri Lanka.

item.title: Alcaraz Battles Past Paul To Book Australian Open QF Spot
item.description: Australian Open QF: World No. 1 Carlos Alcaraz overcame the stern test of Tommy Paul to maintain his commanding start and reach his third consecutive Australian Open quarterfinal here on Sunday.

item.title: Ranji Trophy: Shami Picks Five As Bengal Beat Services To Enter Knockouts
item.description: Bharat Ratna Shri Atal Bihari: Bengal stormed into the quarter-finals of 2025/26 Ranji Trophy after thrashing Services by an innings and 46 runs in their Elite Group C clash at the Bengal Cricket Academy ground on Sunday.
